extracted.intended_audience: issuers, underwriters, counsel and accountants preparing SEC Regulation AB asset-backed securities disclosure (prospectuses and registration statements)
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare and evaluate required disclosure for asset-backed securities under Regulation AB (Items 1104–1111 et al.), including sponsor/depositor/servicer/issuer/asset and pool-specific information for prospectuses and registration statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Static pool summary characteristics
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide material summary characteristics for prior securitized pools or vintage origination years, which may include number of pool assets; original pool balance; weighted average initial loan balance; weighted average interest or note rate; weighted average original term; weighted average remaining term; weighted average and minimum and maximum standardized credit score or other applicable measure of obligor credit quality; product type; loan purpose; loan-to-value information; distribution of assets by loan or note rate; and geographic distribution information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These characteristics may vary by asset type; provide whatever material summary characteristics apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Graphical illustration of vintage performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide graphical illustration of delinquencies, prepayments and losses for each prior securitized pool or by vintage origination year regarding originations or purchases by the sponsor, as applicable for that asset type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use graphics to aid understanding of performance by vintage or prior pools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revolving master trust vintage increments
rubrics_metrics.description: For revolving asset master trusts, unless not material, provide data regarding delinquencies, cumulative losses, prepayments, payment rate, yield and standardized credit scores or other applicable measure of obligor credit quality in separate increments based on date of origination of pool assets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider presenting at a minimum in 12-month increments through the first five years of the account's life (0–12,13–24,25–36,37–48,49–60 and 61+ months) unless different increments are material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative static pool information when material
rubrics_metrics.description: If required static pool information is not material but alternative static pool information would provide material disclosure, provide such alternative information instead and explain why alternative disclosure is provided and the absence of the contemplated static pool information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also may provide information regarding parties other than the sponsor if that is appropriate to provide material disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion from prospectus for pre-2006 data
rubrics_metrics.description: Information provided about prior securitized pools established before January 1, 2006, or about currently offered pool for periods before January 1, 2006, shall not be deemed part of a prospectus or registration statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If prospectus includes such data, it must disclose that the information is not part of prospectus or registration statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Omission when information unavailable without unreasonable effort
rubrics_metrics.description: If information identified (pre-2006 items) is unknown and not available without unreasonable effort or expense, it may be omitted provided the registrant supplies the information it possesses or can acquire without unreasonable effort and includes a statement that unreasonable effort/expense would be involved in obtaining omitted information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicable to paragraph (d)(1) or (d)(2) type information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Depositor information when different from sponsor
rubrics_metrics.description: If the depositor is not the sponsor, separately provide information regarding the depositor called for by paragraphs (a) and (b) of Item 1104, and, if material and materially different, paragraphs (c) and (d) of Item 1104, plus ownership structure; general character of non-securitizing activities and time period; and any continuing duties of the depositor after issuance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include any material differences from sponsor disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issuing entity name and organization
rubrics_metrics.description: State the issuing entity's name and describe its form of organization, including the State or jurisdiction of organization, and file governing documents as an exhibit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issuing entity permissible activities and restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe permissible activities and restrictions under governing documents, including restrictions on issuing/investing in additional securities, borrowing, or loans to others, and any provisions allowing modification of governing documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain material limitations and modification mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issuing entity discretionary administration activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe any specific discretionary activities regarding administration of the asset pool or asset-backed securities and identify persons authorized to exercise such discretion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issuing entity other assets/liabilities and fiscal year
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe any assets owned or to be owned by the issuing entity apart from pool assets, any liabilities apart from the asset-backed securities, and disclose the fiscal year end of the issuing entity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issuing entity executive officers and governance disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: If the issuing entity has executive officers or board-like persons, provide information required by Items 401, 402, 403, 404 and specified parts of 407(a),(c)(3),(d)(4),(d)(5) and (e)(4) of Regulation S‑K for the issuing entity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow cross-referenced Reg S‑K item requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Management/administration agreements for issuing entity
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe terms of any management or administration agreement regarding the issuing entity and file any such agreement as an exhibit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization and equity contributions
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the capitalization of the issuing entity and the amount or nature of any equity contribution to the issuing entity by sponsor, depositor or other party.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sale/transfer/perfection of pool assets
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe sale or transfer of pool assets to the issuing entity and the creation (and perfection and priority status) of any security interest in favor of issuing entity, trustee, ABS holders or others, including material terms of agreements providing for sale/transfer/creation of security interest, and file such agreements as exhibits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide narrative description and also graphical or flow-chart presentation if it will aid understanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Market price disclosure for pool assets that are securities
rubrics_metrics.description: If the pool assets are securities as defined under the Securities Act, state the market price of the securities and the basis on which the market price was determined.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expenses payable from offering proceeds and payees
rubrics_metrics.description: If expenses incurred in selection/acquisition of pool assets are payable from offering proceeds, disclose the amount and, if payable to sponsor/servicer/depositor/originator/underwriter/affiliate, separately identify type and amount paid to each party.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of security interest perfection, bankruptcy and control risks
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe to the extent material any provisions or arrangements regarding: whether security interests are perfected/maintained/enforced; whether bankruptcy/receivership can occur with respect to issuing entity; whether in event of bankruptcy of sponsor/originator/depositor other seller, issuing entity assets will become part of bankruptcy estate or subject to third-party control; and whether in event of bankruptcy of issuing entity its assets will be subject to third-party control.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative holding arrangements when law prohibits direct holding
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicable law prohibits issuing entity from holding the pool assets directly, describe arrangements instituted to hold pool assets on behalf of the issuing entity and include disclosure regarding items in paragraph (k) with respect to any additional entity that holds assets on behalf of issuing entity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., use of eligible lender trustee for FFELP student loans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Servicing structure description when multiple servicers
rubrics_metrics.description: Where servicing uses multiple servicers, provide a clear introductory description of roles, responsibilities and oversight of the entire servicing structure and parties involved, with narrative and consider graphical presentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include allocation of servicing responsibilities and parties' roles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification of material servicers
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify each master servicer; each affiliated servicer; each unaffiliated servicer that services 10% or more of pool assets; and any other material servicer responsible for distributions, workouts/foreclosures, or other materially dependent servicing functions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For unaffiliated servicers servicing 20% or more, provide full servicer disclosure per paragraphs b–e.

rubrics_metrics.name: Servicer identifying information and experience
rubrics_metrics.description: State servicer's name and form of organization; how long the servicer has been servicing assets; general discussion of servicer's experience and detailed discussion of procedures for the servicing function in the current transaction; include, to extent material, size/composition/growth of serviced portfolio and factors material to analysis of servicing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tailor disclosure to the asset type and transaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Servicer material policy/procedure changes
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe any material changes to the servicer's policies or procedures in the servicing function it will perform in the current transaction for assets of the same type during the past three years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Servicer financial condition disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide information regarding servicer's financial condition to the extent there is a material risk that that condition could materially impact pool performance or ABS performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Servicing agreement material terms and exhibit
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe material terms of the servicing agreement and the servicer's duties regarding the transaction and file the servicing agreement as an exhibit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collections maintenance and commingling disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe to the extent material the manner in which collections on the assets will be maintained (e.g., segregated collection account) and the extent of commingling of funds that occurs or may occur from the assets with other funds, serviced assets or other assets of the servicer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Servicer special factors and procedures for asset types
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe material special or unique factors involved in servicing the particular type of assets (e.g., subprime) and the servicer's processes and procedures designed to address such factors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Servicer advances terms and historical statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe terms of any arrangements where servicer is required or permitted to provide advances (including interest/fees and recovery terms). To the extent material, provide statistical information regarding servicer advances on the pool assets and the servicer's overall servicing portfolio for the past three years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Servicer delinquency/loss/bankruptcy handling processes
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the servicer's process for handling delinquencies, losses, bankruptcies and recoveries (e.g., liquidation, note sale by special servicer, borrower negotiation/workouts).

rubrics_metrics.name: Custodial responsibility for assets
rubrics_metrics.description: If the servicer has custodial responsibility, describe material arrangements regarding safekeeping and preservation of assets (e.g., physical promissory notes) and procedures to reflect segregation from other serviced assets; if no servicer has custodial responsibility, disclose that fact and identify the party that has such responsibility and provide corresponding information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Servicer liability limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe any limitations on the servicer's liability under the transaction agreements regarding the asset-backed securities transaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Back-up servicing and transfer provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe material terms regarding servicer removal, replacement, resignation or transfer, including provisions for selection of successor servicer and financial/other requirements, process for transferring servicing, provisions for payment of transfer expenses and additional fees charged by successor, and arrangements/identity of any back-up servicer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify amounts of any funds set aside for servicing transfer if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Servicer retained interest and hedges
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe any interest that the servicer or any affiliate has retained in the transaction, including amount and nature of that interest, and disclose any hedge materially related to credit risk entered into by the servicer or known affiliate to offset risk position held.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction: separately state amount and nature of any interest or asset retained in compliance with law, including amounts retained by parties other than servicer to satisfy such requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trustee identification and organization
rubrics_metrics.description: State each trustee's name and describe the trustee's form of organization and, if applicable, prior experience serving as trustee for ABS transactions involving similar pool assets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trustee duties, required actions and notice triggers
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the trustee's duties/responsibilities under governing documents and applicable law, and any actions required by trustee (including notices to investors, rating agencies or third parties) upon an event of default, potential default (and how defined) or other breach and any required percentage of a class needed to require trustee to take action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trustee liability limits and indemnification
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe any limitations on trustee's liability under the transaction agreements and any indemnification provisions that entitle the trustee to be indemnified from cash flow that otherwise would pay ABS holders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trustee removal/replacement/resignation provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe any contractual provisions or understandings regarding the trustee's removal, replacement or resignation and how expenses associated with changing trustees will be paid.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If multiple trustees, describe roles and responsibilities of each trustee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Asset representations reviewer identification and duties
rubrics_metrics.description: For each asset representations reviewer, state name and form of organization; extent of prior experience as reviewer for similar pool assets; describe duties/responsibilities under governing documents and applicable law and any actions required (including notices and required percentage of a class to require action).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also disclose manner and amount of compensation, liability limitations, indemnification and removal/replacement provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originator identification thresholds
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify any originator or group of affiliated originators (apart from sponsor/affiliates) that originated or is expected to originate 10% or more of pool assets. Also identify originators originating less than 10% if cumulative amount originated by non‑sponsor parties is over 10%.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originator disclosure for ≥20% originators
rubrics_metrics.description: For originators (apart from sponsor) that originated or are expected to originate 20% or more of pool assets, provide form of organization; description of origination program and how long engaged including experience in originating assets of type included; discussion of size/composition of origination portfolio and underwriting/credit-granting criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include information material to analysis of pool performance such as credit-granting or underwriting criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originator retained interest and hedges
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe any interest that the originator or affiliate has retained in the transaction, including amount and nature, and disclose any hedge materially related to credit risk entered into by originator or affiliate to offset risk position held.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction: separately state amount and nature of any interest or asset retained in compliance with law.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originator financial condition when repurchase obligations exist
rubrics_metrics.description: For any originator required to repurchase or replace a pool asset for breach of representation/warranty, provide information regarding originator's financial condition to the extent there is a material risk that such condition could materially impact its ability to comply with repurchase obligations and thus pool or ABS performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pool assets overall descriptive requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the pool assets, present statistical information in tabular or graphical format if helpful, present distributions or incremental ranges in addition to totals/averages/weighted averages, and provide appropriate statistical variables for each group or range to the extent material.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide minimums and maximums when presenting averages; provide historical data (lesser of three years or asset existence) as appropriate to allow material evaluation; disregard funds set aside for a prefunding account when calculating overall pool balances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pool asset types and selection criteria (Item 1111(a))
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide: (1) brief description of type(s) of pool assets; (2) general description of material terms of pool assets; (3) description of solicitation, credit-granting or underwriting criteria used to originate/purchase assets, including changes and possible overrides; (4) method and criteria by which pool assets were selected; (5) cut-off date for composition; (6) identify legal/regulatory provisions that may materially affect performance; (7) nature of review of assets performed by issuer/sponsor (§230.193) and findings/conclusions; (8) disclosure of assets deviating from disclosed underwriting criteria including amount/characteristics and which entity decided to include them and compensating factors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If issuer engaged third-party reviewer and attributes findings to them, provide third-party name and comply with §230.436. If review sampled assets, disclose sample size and selection criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pool characteristics variables
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide material characteristics of the asset pool and methodology used to determine/calculate them, which may include number of each type of pool assets; asset size (original & outstanding balance); interest rate/type; capitalized/un-capitalized accrued interest; age, maturity, remaining term, average life (based on prepayment assumptions), current payment/prepayment speeds and pool factors; servicer distribution; and loan- or asset-specific items such as amortization period, loan purpose/status, LTV/DSCR, collateral/use, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tailor variable choice to asset class; present averages, weighted averages, and distributional groups as helpful.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revolving-account specific metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: If pool includes receivables from revolving accounts (e.g., credit card), disclose monthly payment rate; maximum credit lines; average account balance; yield percentages; type of asset; finance charges, fees and other income earned; balance reductions for refunds/returns/fraud; and percentage of full-balance and minimum payments made.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercial mortgage pool information
rubrics_metrics.description: If pool includes commercial mortgages, provide material information including for all commercial mortgages: location and present use of each mortgaged property; net operating income and net cash flow components; current occupancy rates; identity/sq ft occupied/lease expirations for three largest tenants; other mortgages/liens/priority. For any commercial mortgage representing 10%+ of pool, provide renovation programs, competitive conditions, management, occupancy history, tenant details and lease schedules, average effective annual rental, and ten-year lease expiration schedule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed physical descriptions or metes-and-bounds legal descriptions are not required; focus on information material to investor understanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Security type and collateral description
rubrics_metrics.description: State whether the pool asset is secured or unsecured and, if secured, the type(s) of collateral.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standardized credit scores and obligor quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide standardized credit scores of obligors and other information regarding obligor credit quality to the extent material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Billing and payment procedures disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe billing and payment procedures including frequency of payment, payment options, fees, charges and origination or payment incentives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Origination channel and documentation level
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide information about origination channel and origination process for pool assets, such as originator information (and how acquired) and the level of origination documentation required, as applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic distribution and concentration disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe geographic distribution (by state or other material region). If 10%+ of pool assets are or will be located in one state or region, describe any economic or other factors specific to that state or region that may materially impact assets or cash flows.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For many assets, location is obligor billing address; for real estate-backed assets, location is where physical property is located.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other material concentrations
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose other concentrations material to the asset type (e.g., school type for student loans) and, if material, provide the regional/economic factor discussion as in geographic concentration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delinquency and loss statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide delinquency and loss information for the asset pool, including statistical information regarding delinquencies and losses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present tables/graphs or distributional groupings as appropriate to aid understanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sources of pool cash flow breakdown
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose specific sources of funds to be used to make payments and distributions on the ABS and, if applicable, information on relative amounts/percentages to be derived from each source including assumptions, data, models and methodologies used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If different classes/payments come from different sources, disclose which source funds which payments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Residual value estimation and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: If pool includes leases or assets with residual values, disclose how residual values used to structure the transaction were estimated (including discount rates/models/assumptions and who selected them); material procedures to preserve residual values; procedures by which residual values will be realized and by whom (including experience/affiliations/compensation); whether leases are open-end or closed-end and percentage of each; any lessor obligations affecting ABS; statistical info regarding estimated residual values; historical turn-in and realization rates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also disclose effect on security holders if insufficient cash flow from residual realizations and provisions to address shortfalls and allocation of excess cash.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representations, warranties and remedies summary
rubrics_metrics.description: Summarize representations and warranties concerning pool assets made by sponsor/transferor/originator/other parties and briefly describe remedies available if representations/warranties are breached (e.g., repurchase obligations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Asset modification provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe provisions in transaction agreements governing modification of terms of any asset, including how such modification may affect cash flows from the assets or to the securities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims and cross-collateralization disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe any material direct or contingent claims that parties other than ABS holders have on any pool assets and any material cross-collateralization or cross-default provisions relating to the pool assets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prefunding, revolving and pool-change disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: If transaction contemplates prefunding or revolving period, disclose term/duration; amount of proceeds to be deposited for prefunding; maximum amount of additional assets that may be acquired during revolving period; percentage of asset pool and any class represented by prefunding/revolving account; triggers or events that limit/terminate prefunding/revolving period and effects; operation of revolving and amortization periods; when/how new pool assets may be acquired/removed/substituted and limits on amount/type/speed; acquisition/underwriting criteria for additional assets including differences from current criteria; and which party has authority to add/remove/substitute assets or determine if assets meet criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide comprehensive explanation of mechanics of prefunding/revolving features and governance of asset additions/substitutions.
